It starts with a brief historical description of the motivation for non-commutative geometry and then goes on to motivate the subject from the point of view of the the understanding of local symmetries affordee by the theory of groupoids. verdicts.title: Canonical systems and non-commutative geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Inspired by ideas from non-commutative geometry, unions of moduli spaces of linear control systems are identified as open subsets of infinite Grassmannians.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses moduli spaces of linear control systems as open subsets of infinite Grassmannians, with no mention of resolution proof complexity, k-CNF formulas, or cross section rank bounds. It shares only the 'non-commutative geometry' vocabulary.

verdicts.title: Categorical Non-commutative Geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The purpose of this short note was to outline the current status, then in 2011, of some research programs aiming at a categorification of parts of A.Connes' non-commutative geometry and to provide an outlook on some possible subsequent developments in categorical non-commutative geometry.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes a survey of categorification programs in non-commutative geometry circa 2011, with no mention of random k-CNF formulas, resolution proof width, or local cross section rank bounds.
